reason: The cited lines show HTTP fetches, JSON/text parsing, and returning fetched SVG-derived content, but no arbitrary host code execution. They do not establish that non-public/local/intranet data is actually accessed, though fetchSVGContent accepts a variable URL and returns its contents, so SECRET is not settled. SINK is supported because the code performs fetch(url) where the URL can be a non-fixed value derived from logo.route/svgUrl, i.e. a request to a variable/agent-selected destination; the fixed SVGL search endpoint alone would not be a SINK. UNTRUSTED is supported because data from remote HTTP responses (SVGL API JSON and fetched SVG text) is incorporated into the tool’s returned content.
